meta.name: check-context
meta.description: Accurately check current context window and token usage. Use when the user asks about context usage, token consumption, or when monitoring context levels.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前对话的上下文窗口和令牌用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道当前对话用了多少上下文空间
copy.tagline_en: Check current context window and token usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how much context space is used in the current conversation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能准确报告当前对话的上下文窗口使用百分比、已用和剩余 token 数、会话费用以及当前模型名称。
howto.when: 当用户询问上下文使用情况或 token 消耗时触发。

say.text: 我现在用了多少上下文？
say.note: Claude 会读取状态文件并报告使用百分比。

say.text: 检查一下 token 消耗和费用。
say.note: Claude 会显示输入/输出 token 数和总费用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can accurately report the current context window usage percentage, used and remaining tokens, session cost, and model name.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about context usage or token consumption.

say_en.text: How much context am I using?
say_en.note: Claude reads the status file and reports usage percentage.
Claude shows input/output tokens and total cost.
